description.en-US: Private, self-hosted Android apps on Logos — no Google, no accounts, no central server. Peers: a peer-to-peer messenger over Logos, MeshCore (LoRa) and Bluetooth mesh, end-to-end and at-rest encrypted. Booth & Receiver: broadcast and tune in to decentralised anonymous radio over Tor + Logos Messaging.

summary.en-US: Private peer-to-peer messenger over Logos, MeshCore & Bluetooth

description.en-US:
A private, peer-to-peer messenger. Your identity lives on this device — no phone
number, no account, no central server, no Google.

Reach people over three transports: Logos (a pure-Rust delivery node), MeshCore
(LoRa radio), or Bluetooth mesh — one shared timeline, colour-coded by transport.
1:1 and group chats are end-to-end encrypted with MLS; send voice notes, images,
camera photos, and location. Works offline over Bluetooth/LoRa when the network
is down.

Your messages, encryption keys, and identity are encrypted at rest (Android
Keystore + SQLCipher). Optional PIN lock with an auto-lock and duress-wipe.
